title: Pivotask board
description: One board, one file. The root object IS the board — no wrapping array, no board id, no in-app board switcher (proposal 0004 §10.9). More boards means more files.

version.description: The schema version. A reader whose major version is behind this one must refuse the file rather than half-read it.

labels.description: The board's label vocabulary, referenced by id from tasks. In the document, not a constant: fixed palettes don't survive contact with real users (§4).

$comment: additionalProperties is deliberately NOT false, at every level. A file written by a newer Pivotask must survive being opened and saved by an older one, so every object round-trips the properties it didn't recognise (§4).

id.description: A short opaque id: seven base-36 characters from a cryptographic RNG. Short because a person reads these in a git diff and types them at the CLI; random rather than sequential because two people adding a task on two branches must not produce the same one.

collapsed.description: Whether the column is folded shut. A view state, but persisted: it is how a board with twelve columns stays usable.

notes.description: Plain multi-line text. Never Markdown (§10.4): a note attached to a task is a sentence or two, and if it genuinely wants to be a document, that document is a .md file.

due.description: A date, never a time. YYYY-MM-DD, with no timezone anywhere near it — 'Thursday' is what people mean by a due date, and the moment a time is stored the question of whose Thursday arrives with it.

labels.description: Label ids, referencing the root-level labels[].

step.description: One checklist item. Exactly one level deep — subtasks do not nest (§8).
